company.founder: Hyperbliss was founded by **Stefanie Jane**, who created [CyanogenMod](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/CyanogenMod) (now [LineageOS](https://lineageos.org/)) and co-founded the company behind it. Millions of people used it to take control of their phones. She has been building technology for over 25 years, and Hyperbliss carries the same idea forward.
company.lede: Hyperbliss Technologies is an independent software company in Seattle. We make software that puts people in control of their own technology.
